message.content:
**Your 7‑Day Paris Adventure – A Complete Itinerary**

> *Assumptions:*  
> • You’re flying from a major U.S. hub (e.g., JFK, LAX, ORD).  
> • You’ll stay in a 3‑star hotel or boutique Airbnb in the 1st‑7th arrondissements (central, walkable).  
> • Budget: $2,500–$3,500 per person (mid‑range).  
> • Travel dates: mid‑April (pleasant weather, fewer crowds than summer).  

---

## Day 0 – Arrival & Settling In

| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| 12:00 PM | Arrive at Charles de Gaulle (CDG) | Take the RER B to Gare du Nord (≈35 min, €10). |
| 1:30 PM | Check‑in | Hotel/hostel in the 1st or 4th arrondissement. |
| 3:00 PM | Light stroll | Walk to **Louvre** (just outside the museum). Grab a croissant & café at **Café Marly**. |
| 5:00 PM | Relax | Return to hotel, freshen up. |
| 7:30 PM | Dinner | **Le Petit Cler** (French bistro, €25‑€35). |

> **Tip:** Get a **Paris Pass** (or a **Navigo Week Pass**) for unlimited metro/bus rides and free entry to many museums.

---

## Day 1 – Classic Landmarks

| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| 9:00 AM | **Notre‑Dame** & **Sainte‑Chapelle** | Early visit to avoid crowds. |
| 11:00 AM | **Île de la Cité** walk | Explore the Latin Quarter. |
| 1:00 PM | Lunch | **Le Procope** (oldest café, €30). |
| 2:30 PM | **Louvre Museum** | Pre‑book tickets; 3‑hour tour. |
| 5:30 PM | **Tuileries Garden** | Relax, people‑watch. |
| 7:30 PM | Dinner | **Café Marly** or **L’Atelier de Joël Robuchon** (if you want a splurge). |

---

## Day 2 – Art & Culture

| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| 9:00 AM | **Musée d’Orsay** | Impressionist masterpieces. |
| 12:00 PM | Lunch | **Café Campana** (inside Musée d’Orsay). |
| 2:00 PM | **Musée Rodin** | Beautiful sculptures & gardens. |
| 4:30 PM | **Luxembourg Gardens** | Picnic (pick up baguette, cheese, wine). |
| 7:00 PM | Dinner | **Le Coupe Chou** (cozy, classic French). |

---

## Day 3 – Montmartre & Nightlife

| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| 9:00 AM | **Sacré‑Coeur** | Panoramic city view. |
| 11:00 AM | Wander **Montmartre** | Artists’ square, Place du Tertre. |
| 1:00 PM | Lunch | **La Maison Rose** (iconic spot). |
| 3:00 PM | **Espace Dalí** | Surreal art. |
| 5:30 PM | Return to hotel | Rest. |
| 7:30 PM | Dinner | **Le Consulat** (historic). |
| 9:00 PM | **Moulin Rouge** show** (optional)** | Book in advance. |

---

## Day 4 – Day Trip to Versailles

| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| 8:00 AM | **RER C** to Versailles Château | 45 min, €7. |
| 9:00 AM | **Palace & Gardens** | Guided tour (€15). |
| 12:00 PM | Lunch | **La Petite Venise** (inside palace). |
| 2:00 PM | **Grand Trianon** & **Queen’s Hamlet** | Explore. |
| 4:30 PM | Return to Paris | |
| 7:00 PM | Dinner | **Le Relais de l’Entrecôte** (famous steak). |

---

## Day 5 – Modern Paris & Shopping

| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| 9:00 AM | **Centre Pompidou** | Contemporary art. |
| 11:30 AM | **Le Marais** | Boutiques, vintage shops. |
| 1:00 PM | Lunch | **L’As du Fallafel** (budget). |
| 3:00 PM | **Picasso Museum** | 2‑hour visit. |
| 5:30 PM | **Champs‑Élysées** | Walk to Arc de Triomphe. |
| 7:30 PM | Dinner | **L’Avenue** (fancy, celebrity spot). |

---

## Day 6 – River Cruise & Eiffel Tower

| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| 9:00 AM | **Seine River Cruise** | 1‑hour, €15. |
| 11:00 AM | **Eiffel Tower** | Pre‑book summit tickets (€25). |
| 1:30 PM | Lunch | **58 Tour Eiffel** (restaurant inside tower). |
| 3:30 PM | **Champ de Mars** | Relax, photo ops. |
| 5:00 PM | **Musée Quai Branly** | Indigenous art. |
| 7:30 PM | Dinner | **Le Jules Verne** (splurge) or **Bistro du Peintre** (budget). |

---

## Day 7 – Leisure & Departure

| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| 9:00 AM | **Breakfast** | **Café de Flore** (iconic). |
| 10:30 AM | **Last‑minute shopping** | **Galeries Lafayette** or **Printemps**. |
| 12:30 PM | **Pack & Check‑out** | |
| 2:00 PM | **Departure** | RER B to CDG. |

---

## Practical Tips

| Category | Recommendation |
|----------|----------------|
| **Transport** | Buy a **Navigo Week Pass** (€22.80) for unlimited metro/bus. Use **Uber** or **Bolt** for late‑night rides. |
| **Dining** | Reserve restaurants 2–3 days ahead. Try **bouchons** in Lyon‑style for authentic French cuisine. |
| **Language** | Learn basic phrases: “Bonjour”, “Merci”, “Combien ça coûte?”. |
| **Safety** | Keep valuables in a money belt. Beware of pickpockets near major attractions. |
| **Weather** | Pack layers; April can be cool (10–18 °C). Bring an umbrella. |
| **Cash** | €1,000–€1,500 in cash for tips, small purchases. Most places accept cards. |

---

## Budget Breakdown (per person)

| Item | Cost (USD) |
|------|------------|
| Flights (round‑trip) | $700–$1,200 |
| Accommodation (7 nights) | $1,200–$1,800 |
| Food & Drinks | $600–$800 |
| Attractions & Tours | $300–$400 |
| Transport (Paris Pass + RER) | $150 |
| Miscellaneous (souvenirs, tips) | $200 |
| **Total** | **$3,250–$4,250** |

*(Prices fluctuate; book early for best rates.)*

---

## Optional Enhancements

| Activity | Why It’s Worth It |
|----------|------------------|
| **Wine & Cheese Tasting** | Experience French terroir. |
| **Cooking Class** | Learn to make croissants or coq au vin. |
| **Night at the Opera** | Spectacular performances at Palais Garnier. |
| **Bike Tour** | Explore hidden neighborhoods. |

---

### Final Checklist

- [ ] Passport valid for at least 6 months.  
- [ ] Travel insurance (covers health & cancellations).  
- [ ] Print or download all reservations.  
- [ ] Pack a reusable water bottle (Paris has many refill stations).  
- [ ] Download offline maps (Google Maps offline or Citymapper).  

Enjoy your Paris adventure! If you’d like to tweak the itinerary (e.g., add a day in the countryside, adjust budget, or focus on culinary experiences), just let me know. Bon voyage!
